items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser keeps the base of your routine simple while you add actives.
Niacinamide 10% suits skin labelled oily and helps the look of shine and an even-looking tone in the morning.
A low-strength retinol is a sensible first active for smoother-looking skin over time, and your scores show no need for something stronger.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier and helps your moisture score while you ease into retinol.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, niacinamide, moisturizer, then SPF 50 every day. Evenings: cleanse, apply a pea-sized amount of retinol 2 nights a week and build slowly to every other night as comfortable, then moisturize.
